question: Were you a U.S. citizen for all of last year?
why_ask: Non-citizens may be resident or nonresident aliens for tax purposes, which changes the return.
retrieval_query: resident alien nonresident alien who must file

question: Did you have a green card (lawful permanent resident status) at any time in 2025?
why_ask: A green card holder is a resident alien for tax purposes and is taxed like a U.S. citizen; Form 8843 is for nonimmigrant visa holders.
retrieval_query: lawful permanent resident green card test resident alien
origin: Pub 4012 (Rev. 10-2026) Tab L, Substantial Presence Test Decision Chart 1 (Student) (structure only); Resident or Nonresident Alien Decision Tree step 1

question: What visa were you in the U.S. on as a student in 2025: F, J, M, Q, or another visa?
why_ask: Students on F, J, M or Q visas can be exempt individuals whose days do not count for the substantial presence test (Form 8843, Part I line 1a and Part III).
retrieval_query: exempt individual student F J M Q visa days not counted substantial presence test
origin: IRS Form 8843 (2025) Part I line 1a, Part III; Pub 4012 (Rev. 10-2026) Tab L, Substantial Presence Test Decision Chart 1 (Student) (structure only)

question: Did you follow the requirements of your student visa during 2025 (for example full-time enrollment and authorized work only)?
why_ask: Days can be excluded as an exempt student only if the student substantially complied with the visa requirements (Pub 4012 Tab L, step 2).
retrieval_query: student exempt individual substantially complied with visa requirements
origin: Pub 4012 (Rev. 10-2026) Tab L, Substantial Presence Test Decision Chart 1 (Student) (structure only), step 2

question: Counting 2025, were you in the U.S. as a student, teacher or trainee (F, J, M or Q visa) during any part of more than 5 calendar years?
why_ask: A student stops being an exempt individual after 5 calendar years unless an exception applies (Form 8843, Part III line 12).
retrieval_query: student exempt for more than 5 calendar years Form 8843 line 12
origin: IRS Form 8843 (2025) Part III line 12; Pub 4012 (Rev. 10-2026) Tab L, Substantial Presence Test Decision Chart 1 (Student) (structure only), step 3

question: During 2025, did you apply for, or take other steps toward, a green card (lawful permanent resident status)?
why_ask: Steps toward permanent residence are asked on Form 8843 (Part III line 13) and can stop days from being excluded.
retrieval_query: applied for lawful permanent resident status Form 8843 student
